newsitem.title: USA: Bandag expenses to weigh on '97 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Bandag expenses to weigh on '97 earnings.

text.p: Bandag Inc, reporting lower first-quarter earnings due to higher operating expenses, said strategic expenses in the near term will make it difficult for the company to achieve increased earnings for full-year 1997.

"The company is entering a period of strategic expansion which will require increased spending for training, product development, sales, marketing and distribution initiatives around the world," said chairman Martin Carver in a statement.
For the first quarter, the manufacturer of retreading materials reported earnings of $0.60 per share, down from $0.65 a year ago. Sales were $169.5 million compared to $170.3 million.
